data.name: Art of Balboa Park Walking Tour
data.headline: Newest Tour!  Gardens, ornate architecture, beauty and history in Balboa Park
data.description: Balboa Park is a unique urban park with rich history from the very beginnings of San Diego.  The park represents self-love, wonder, beauty and culture throughout every corner.  Styled in the Spanish Revival fashion of architecture of buildings that now house many museums, restaurants, and education program venues, and the gardens are lush and full of flowering plants and ponds.  The park is an escape from the day-to-day hustle of city life.  Enjoy a guided stroll around the park, and get a deeper appreciation for its beauty and history.

meeting_point.address: 2135 Pan American Plaza San Diego, CA US 92101

data.what_is_included:
🏙️ Walking History Tour – Explore historic buildings and landmarks of San Diego’s Balboa Park with a local expert

📚 Untold Tales – Learn the fascinating facts they don’t teach in school

🌇 Atmospheric Stroll Through Balboa Park's Hidden Gardens – Learn about the various plants that were brought to San Diego from all around the world
data.what_to_bring: Please wear comfortable walking shoes, and bring a bottle of water.
data.cancellation_notes: Your tour may be cancelled for a full refund up to 48 hours before the scheduled time of your tour.  In the event that our tour does not meet the minimum number of guests required to operate the tour, So Diego may reach out with an alternate date and time, or offer a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
Please arrive **10 minutes** before your scheduled tour time.  Please note that the tour price does not include guide gratuity.  Our guides work very hard to make your tour special, and always appreciate a little extra love ;)
